authorization_basis: User go after 07930f0: separately freeze and run the 30 pure mechanics tests before considering bootstrap execution.

source.prime_identity_scope: Inherited committed subject only; no dirty-tree hash or new live source closure

tool_identities.snapshot_scope: Physical target bytes and named/target metadata, aliases and SDK root/settings before compilation, before tests, and after tests. Not a held execution closure.

metadata.namespace: All sixteen entries under each source root: six files and ten directories including source and Observability ancestors; no symlinks, extra files or empty extra directories.
metadata.decimal_handling: Retain raw strings; split integer seconds and nine-digit fractional nanoseconds as decimal strings, never through JavaScript Number/Double.
metadata.formatter_qualification: Published Apple file_cmds-479 FLOAT precision9 implementation formats integer seconds and nanoseconds, corresponding to installed stat's declared project string. This is source-version correspondence, not a reproducible binary build proof; pin installed stat hash and retain raw output strings.
metadata.double_snapshot_rule: Metadata before hashing must equal metadata after hashing, and the full corresponding preflight/postflight tuples must match. Byte-only checks cannot satisfy the barrier.
metadata.limitation: Named-file observations with detection before/after, not an atomic held descriptor closure; mutation and restore entirely between observations can escape detection.

creation.root_and_children: Require fresh absent root; exclusive mkdir, private mode0700 outer/T roots and child directories. No reuse, cleanup or deletion.

builds.label: T
builds.transport: Non-login /bin/zsh, exec /usr/bin/env -i with the exact replacement environment and swift-build argv; stdin/dev/null, exclusive separate stdout/stderr logs, no outer timeout or signals

test.label: T
test.transport: Non-login /bin/zsh, exec /usr/bin/env -i with the exact replacement environment and swift-test argv; stdin/dev/null, exclusive separate stdout/stderr logs, no outer timeout or signals

test_scope.test_parallelism: --no-parallel; the one-shot concurrency case deliberately starts 64 bounded Swift tasks, not processes
test_scope.build_scope: Build source and test targets plus SwiftPM-generated test runner; bootstrap executable may be compiled/linked but must never be executed. No worker source/target is included.
test_scope.pure_reachability: Exact test bodies call receipt/anchor/SHA, completeness, latch, synthetic child-state, rational deadline, endpoint and sequencer functions only. They never call public GateEStaticBootstrap.run(), native gebs_ primitives or live Run.
test_scope.capability_qualification: Core and native primitives remain linked and public run() exists. Purity is an exact-source call-path property, not an inability of the test image to actuate and not a kernel sandbox.
test_scope.synthetic_child_semantics: commitKill returns a synthetic positive PID in memory; no kill syscall, child, waitpid, process observation or conservation proof is exercised.

order: full source/tool revalidation plus generated runner/test image admission persisted
normal test exit0 and all30 expected tests pass
complete source/tool/test-image postflight and durable result
test_requires: Full 16-entry source metadata and inventory before/after hash match preflight
Six source hashes match committed source pins
Generated test image has one regular nlink1 executable at the SwiftPM output, SHA256 and full before/after metadata retained
Generated test-runner source retained and hashed; no unexpected package test suite or runtime entry
build-postflight-test-admission.json persisted before test transport entry
sequencing.generated_image_selection: Inspect the single generated ErgenticsGateEStaticBootstrapPackageTests image under the exact scratch/debug directory (flat executable or standard .xctest/Contents/MacOS layout). Require exactly one; SwiftPM --skip-build selects its built runner, no direct alternate path launch.
sequencing.transport: Each stage is a non-login /bin/zsh exec /usr/bin/env -i with exact argv/environment, stdin /dev/null, exclusive regular stdout/stderr captures. No outer timeout, signals, retry or cleanup. Standard native tools and local JS orchestration only.
sequencing.compiler_scope: Manifest/compiler/plugin macro/linker processes required by Swift/Testing compilation are permitted; no external dependency or package plugin. --jobs1 is build scheduling, not a single-thread or CPU bound.
sequencing.test_runtime_scope: One SwiftPM test-command entry, only the generated Swift Testing runner for this one package. --skip-build forbids rebuilding package source/test products. Loading/evaluating the package manifest, including a cache-miss manifest compiler helper, is permitted and must be reported if observed; it is not a second package-source build.
sequencing.failure: Stop on any failed compilation/admission/test/predicate. Retain diagnostics; no source repair, binary rewrite or retry in this frozen phase.
sequencing.historical: Prior worker-build pre-B omission stays historical FAIL/UNOBSERVED; this test phase does not repair it.

success_predicates: Compilation and test command both normal exit0
Exactly all 30 expected tests start and pass once; zero failures/issues/skips/unknown/missing/duplicate tests; final Swift Testing summary reports30
No bootstrap or worker invocation in frozen test bodies or retained command logs
All required full pre/mid/post source and tool snapshots match
Test image bytes and full metadata unchanged through test interval
Frozen bootstrap runtime root absent before and after
All retained artifacts hashed in result
residuals: env -i is replacement environment, not filesystem/process/network confinement; non-login zsh briefly inherits ambient local environment.
--disable-sandbox disables SwiftPM nested sandbox only; Codex sandbox remains active.
Source/tool/image pre/post checks are named observations, not held descriptor joins; an inter-observation mutate/restore can evade them.
Transitive SDK, system Testing/runtime libraries and compiler execution closure are not exhaustively admitted.
macOS26.5.2 arm64 execution with minimum14 target is not a macOS14/15 or x86_64 runtime test.
Synthetic PASS receipts, vnode tuples and child statuses are fixtures, never production evidence.
Debug tests validate source mechanics, not execution of the paired Release binary.
Capture command-entry/return UTC and tool durations as wall metadata only; no exact CPU, energy, ergs or old-process observation.
The frozen pure test loops are bounded, but compiler, Testing runtime or kernel hangs have no guaranteed finite completion. No outer timeout signal or manual containment action is authorized.
next: If all mechanics pass, prepare a fresh bootstrap runtime-admission freeze. No bootstrap or worker launch is included here.
